info.title: Daily Brief API
info.summary: Contract shared by the web app, the future iOS app, and the agent worker.
info.description:
Single contract for the Daily Brief backend. Client types are generated from this file.

Full URLs are `/api/v1/...` (public), `/api/health`, and `/api/internal/...` (worker only).

**Authentication** (DESIGN 3.4, `docs/auth-passkey-design.md`). Users sign in with passkeys
(WebAuthn). Every `/v1` route requires the session cookie (`sessionCookie`), except the four
public sign-in operations under `/v1/auth/registration/*` and `/v1/auth/login/*`. A session is
valid only if it is unrevoked, within its idle and absolute lifetime and `profiles.status` is
`active`; a `kind='passkey'` session also needs its passkey to be active and owned by the same user,
and a `kind='dev'` session is accepted only when `APP_ENV=local`. Otherwise 401 `unauthorized`. Every `/internal` route requires the
service token in `X-Internal-Token` (`internalToken`). `/v1` rejects the internal token and any
`Authorization: Bearer` header (401 `unauthorized`), on public sign-in operations too; `/internal`
rejects session cookies. `/health` is unauthenticated.

**Request rules for `/v1`.** Every unsafe method (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), including the public
sign-in operations and logout, needs exactly one `Origin` header equal to a configured origin,
otherwise 403 `origin_mismatch`. Operations with a body need `Content-Type: application/json`
(415 `unsupported_media_type`); bodyless operations accept an empty body. Public sign-in bodies
are limited to 64 KB (413 `payload_too_large`). Check order: route family, body size, Origin,
media type, rate limit, authentication, reauthentication, validation, state conflict. All `/api`
responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`. `/internal` does not check `Origin`.

**Registration gate.** A profile is created only by `registerVerify` with an invite token, or by
the admin CLI for the owner. Signing in never creates a profile. `status` is `active` or
`disabled`. A disabled account's sessions are revoked, so session-authenticated routes return 401;
the public sign-in and registration operations return 403 `account_disabled`, at login only after a
valid passkey proof.

**Errors.** All errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`Problem`) with a
machine-readable `code`.

servers.description: Same origin as the frontend; routed to the API.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Passkey sign-in, sessions and passkey management.

tags.name: subscriptions
tags.description: Topic subscriptions, item counts and order.

tags.name: marks
tags.description: Read state and notes on items.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: On-demand brief generation ("Generate now") and its status.

get.description: Returns only status ok, no data. No authentication.
Returns 401 when not signed in; the web app shows the sign-in page then.

post.summary: Start registering a passkey with an enrollment token
post.description:
Public. The token comes from the enrollment link's URL fragment. Validates the token without
using it, increments its lifetime `options_count` (limit 10, committed even on failure), creates a
ceremony bound to this browser (sets or refreshes the browser-binding cookie) and returns
WebAuthn creation options. `display_name` is accepted only for invite tokens. Invite tokens and
tokens for a non-owner are refused with 403 `admission_disabled` while non-owner admission is off.

Public. Verifies the attestation (user verification required) and, in one transaction, creates the
profile (invite), replaces all old passkeys and sessions (recovery) or adds a passkey
(add_credential), uses the token and starts a new session. A valid but failed proof consumes the
ceremony; a request from another browser consumes nothing.

post.summary: Start signing in with a passkey
post.description: Public. Returns request options with an empty `allowCredentials` (discoverable passkeys).

post.summary: Finish signing in with a passkey
post.description:
Public. Any failed proof returns the same 401 `authentication_failed` body (unknown, revoked or
mismatched credential, bad signature, missing user verification, counter regression on a
device-bound passkey). 403 `account_disabled` only after a valid proof.
No body. Revokes the current session and clears the cookie (same name and attributes, `Max-Age=0`).
No body. `allowCredentials` lists the caller's active passkeys. The ceremony is bound to this session.
The passkey must belong to the session's user. On success sensitive actions are allowed for 5 minutes.

post.summary: Start adding a passkey on this device
post.description: No body. Needs a reauthentication within 5 minutes. `excludeCredentials` lists the caller's active passkeys.
The reauthentication must still be within 5 minutes. At most 10 active passkeys per user.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's passkeys
delete.description:
Needs a reauthentication within 5 minutes. Refused for the last active passkey (409 `last_passkey`).
Revokes every session created with it; if that includes the current session, the response also
clears the cookie. Another user's id is 404.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's sessions
delete.description: Revoking the current session is the same as logout. Another user's id is 404.

post.summary: Subscribe to an existing topic or a new topic title
post.description: Send either `topic_id` or `title` (creates a private topic). Duplicate returns 409 `already_subscribed`.

patch.summary: Update item count, order or enabled flag

200.description: Slots and the timezone they are interpreted in.

put.summary: Replace the full set of delivery slots
put.description:
Replaces all slots. More than 3 returns 422 `slot_limit_exceeded`; duplicate
`local_time` values return 422 (`duplicate_slot`). Positions are assigned by array order.

get.summary: List the caller's reports for a date

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Report date. Defaults to today in the caller's timezone.

get.summary: Get one report with sections, items and the caller's marks
get.description: Only the caller's own reports; others return 404.

put.summary: Set read state and note on an item
put.description: Notes are plain text and must always be rendered as plain text.

get.summary: Get agent settings (display only in the POC)

patch.summary: Update agent settings (reserved in the POC)
patch.description:
Defined for forward compatibility. In the POC every field is reserved: the API rejects
any change with 403 code `agent_settings_locked`.

200.description: Updated settings (not reachable in the POC).

403.description: Code `agent_settings_locked` (every change in the POC) or `origin_mismatch`.

post.summary: Queue a brief for the caller now ("Generate now")
post.description:
Creates one on-demand job for the caller (`slot_id` null, `scheduled_for` = now) with the runner
from the caller's agent settings, commits it, then dispatches the worker. No request body.
- Counts toward `daily_run_limit`, together with scheduled jobs, in the same day window the
  scheduler uses (the caller's timezone). Over the limit: 429 `daily_limit_reached`.
- At most one `queued` or `running` job per user, checked atomically: otherwise 409 `job_in_progress`.
- The caller needs at least one enabled subscription: otherwise 422 `no_topics`.
- Runner `claude_subscription` and the caller is not the configured owner: 403 `owner_only`,
  and no job is created (DESIGN 3.1).
- A dispatch failure does not fail the request: the job stays `queued` and the next scheduler
  tick dispatches it again.

429.description: `daily_limit_reached` (no `Retry-After`; try again the next day) or `rate_limited`.

get.summary: Status of one of the caller's jobs
get.description: For polling after `generateNow`. Another user's job is 404.

post.summary: Worker claims the next queued job
post.description:
Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only; a user JWT is rejected with 401.
Marks the job `running` and increments `attempts`.

200.description: A claimed job and its request.

post.description:
Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only. In one transaction the API stores the report,
sections, items and usage and marks the job `succeeded`.
409 `lease_lost` if the job is not `running` or `attempt` does not match;
422 if the body fails the BriefResult schema, or 422 `invalid_rank` if item ranks in a section
are not exactly 1..n in array order. Sections are validated against topics owned by the job's
user (not the user's current subscriptions), so settings edited mid-run do not reject output.

Authenticated with `X-Internal-Token` only. If `retryable` and attempts remain, the job
returns to `queued`; otherwise it becomes `failed`. 409 `lease_lost` if `attempt` does not match.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-brief_session

internalToken.name: X-Internal-Token
internalToken.description: Service token for the worker. Accepted on `/internal` routes only.

Attempt.name: attempt
Attempt.description:
Lease fencing. The `job.attempts` value returned by `POST /internal/jobs/claim`. The API accepts
the call only while the job is `running` with exactly this attempt number; otherwise 409 `lease_lost`
(the lease expired and the job was re-queued or re-claimed).

SessionCookie.description:
Sets the session cookie `__Host-brief_session=<token>; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/;
Max-Age=<seconds until absolute_expires_at>` (host-only, no `Domain`). Clearing uses the same name
and attributes with `Max-Age=0`. Locally (`APP_ENV=local`) the name is
`brief_session_<COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME>` and `Secure` is omitted.

BindingCookie.description:
Sets or refreshes the browser-binding cookie `__Host-brief_ceremony=<random>; Secure; HttpOnly;
SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=600` (host-only, no `Domain`). An existing well-formed value is
reused, so several ceremonies in one browser can run at once. Locally the name is
`brief_ceremony_<COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME>` and `Secure` is omitted.

Unauthorized.description:
Missing, invalid, expired or revoked session, or a wrong-kind credential such as a Bearer token or
the internal token on `/v1` (code `unauthorized`).

ForbiddenAccount.description: Request gate on unsafe methods: `origin_mismatch` (missing, `null`, duplicate or unknown `Origin`).

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not owned by the caller (code `not_found`).

Unprocessable.description:
Validation failed (code `validation_error`, or a specific code such as
`slot_limit_exceeded`, `duplicate_slot`, `visibility_not_supported`).

AuthBadRequest.description:
`ceremony_invalid` (unknown, expired, consumed, wrong purpose or other browser),
`registration_failed` (attestation rejected), `enrollment_token_invalid` (unknown, revoked or
superseded), `validation_error` or `bad_request`.

AuthenticationFailed.description:
`authentication_failed` for any failed passkey proof (the body is identical for every cause), or
`unauthorized` for a wrong-family credential (Bearer, internal token) or, on reauth, a missing,
expired or revoked session.

ReauthRequired.description: `reauth_required` (no reauthentication in the last 5 minutes) or `origin_mismatch`.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Body over 64 KB (code `payload_too_large`), checked before decoding.

enrollment_token.description: Base64url token from the enrollment link fragment. Never logged.

public_key.description:
WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form of `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` (registration, add passkey) or
`PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions` (login, reauth), base64url-encoded binary fields. Pass to
`PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON` / `parseRequestOptionsFromJSON` or an
equivalent helper.

WebAuthnCredential.description: WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form of the `PublicKeyCredential` returned by the browser (`toJSON()`).

is_current.description: The current session was created with this passkey.

SubscriptionCreate.description: Either an existing `topic_id` or a new topic `title`.

slots.description: Full replacement set. `local_time` values must be unique.

timezone.description: IANA zone the slots are interpreted in.

mark.description: The caller's mark, or null if none.

AgentSettingsUpdate.description: All fields are reserved in the POC; any change returns 403 `agent_settings_locked`.

UserJob.description: A job as its owner sees it. Never includes worker output, prompts or raw errors.

error_code.description: Short code when `status` is `failed`, e.g. `worker_failed`, `owner_only`. Never free text.

BriefResult.title: BriefResult
BriefResult.description: Output of an AgentRunner for one BriefRequest. The worker validates it before posting to /internal/jobs/{job_id}/result; the API validates it again.

note.description: Used when status is insufficient_news or when sources disagree (for example on a number).

items.description: Ordered by importance. Each item's rank equals its 1-based position (enforced by prefixItems).

Section.$comment: status ok requires at least one item; insufficient_news may have zero items (never pad).

rank.description: Equals the item's 1-based position in the section's items array.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences in the agent's own words.

source_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL with a non-empty host, actually found by the agent.
